Callout.Name: Cash Van Ambush
Callout.Message: Crew ambushed while loading a cash machine.
Callout.Advisory: Two suspects on foot, cash box taken.

Script.Line: It was not us. We were on the other side of the road.
Two of them and they went into the estate on foot.
One of them had something in their hand. I am not saying what.

Lines.Approach: They took the box and went on foot into the estate. The crew are shaken and unhurt.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
